problems.form_value: Students at two domestic (Korean) universities taking IT-related courses; 121 men and 43 women; year and major not collected.
problems.source_says: The paper says the authors could not collect year and major information systematically (체계적으로 수집하지 못하였으므로). It does not say the information was not collected at all, so the form overstates. Suggested wording: 'year and major not systematically collected'. This is a wording fix only. No count changes, and criterion 2 is unaffected.
problems.quote: 다만 본 연구에서는 참여자의 학년 및 전공 정보를 체계적으로 수집하지 못하였으므로, 이러한 배경 변인이 창의적 아이디어 생성에 미칠 수 있는 영향은 본 연구에서 직접 통제하지 못하였다.
problems.locator: PDF p. 5 (journal p. 44), Section 3.1, paragraph that gives the analyzed sample

confirmed.statement: S1 analyzed 164 people: round-1 groups A 83 and B 81, round-2 arms A1 43, A2 40, B1 41, B2 40. Section 3.1 states this, Section 4.1 repeats it, and each box in Figure 1 shows the same n. The form's n_analyzed matches the total and all six arms.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5 (journal p. 44), Section 3.1; PDF p. 6 (journal p. 45), Section 4.1; Figure 1, PDF p. 4 (journal p. 43)

confirmed.statement: The same total of 164 appears in the Korean and English abstracts, the Introduction, Section 5.1, and the limitations in Section 5.2. The paper gives no other total.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 1 (journal p. 40), abstracts; PDF p. 2 (journal p. 41), Introduction; PDF p. 8 (journal p. 47), Section 5.1; PDF p. 9 (journal p. 48), Section 5.2

confirmed.statement: The counts are people. The paper counts them in 명 (persons) and says the unit of analysis is the individual. The sex split adds up (121 + 43 = 164). The 328 in Section 3.2.4 counts outputs (164 people x 2 rounds), and the form uses it only for the ICCs. Each outcome has unit participant and n_units null, as the codebook requires.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5 (journal p. 44), Section 3.1; PDF p. 6 (journal p. 45), Section 3.2.4

confirmed.statement: The arm counts reproduce every reported statistic. The Table 3 df (42, 39, 40, 39) equal n - 1. Recomputed Welch df and t match Table 1 (81.00, 0.53; 77.19, 0.38) and H1 (159.54, 13.29), and the paired t for H2 has 163 df. Arm-weighted means give A 63.07, B 29.66 (29.65 printed, a rounding difference), round 1 46.57, and round 2 60.93. With 164 people scored twice, the gain SDs give mixed-model SEs of 2.49, 2.47, and 1.71, as printed.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 6 (journal p. 45), Table 1 and Section 4.2; PDF p. 7 (journal p. 46), Tables 2-4 and Section 4.3; PDF pp. 7-8 (journal pp. 46-47), Section 4.4.2

confirmed.statement: n_randomized = null is right for the study and all six arms. The paper gives only analyzed counts (분석에 포함된 참여자, 분석대상자). It never says how many people started, were assigned, or dropped out. It has no flow diagram, no appendix, and no supplement. This follows the form-spec rule 'randomized only for a count the paper gives at assignment'.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5 (journal p. 44), Section 3.1; PDF p. 6 (journal p. 45), Section 4.1; PDF pp. 1-10; form-spec.md, 'Counts in prose'

confirmed.statement: The exclusions field matches the paper: only participants who wrote both outputs were included (1차 및 2차 산출물을 모두 작성한 참여자만 포함하였다). Searches for 제외, 탈락, 누락, 결측, 중도, and 불참 find nothing. Students were randomized before round 2, so this rule can drop people after assignment. The paper gives no number for this. The form calls the analysis completers-only and never calls it intention-to-treat.

All three randomization statements describe the round-2 draw within A and within B: the Introduction, Section 3.1 step (3), and Section 5.1. So each of the 164 analyzed people was randomized at round 2, 83 in stratum A and 81 in stratum B. The paper never says how people entered A or B.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 2 (journal p. 41), Introduction; PDF p. 5 (journal p. 44), Section 3.1, step (3); PDF p. 8 (journal p. 47), Section 5.1

confirmed.statement: The arms nest: A = A1 + A2 (43 + 40 = 83) and B = B1 + B2 (41 + 40 = 81). The six arm counts sum to 328, twice the 164 people. The form's study total is 164, and its A and B descriptions say 'the union of', so nobody is counted twice. Each coded contrast uses disjoint arms: B1 vs B2 81, A1 vs A2 83, A vs B 164, A2 vs B2 80.
confirmed.locator: Figure 1, PDF p. 4 (journal p. 43); Table 4, PDF p. 7 (journal p. 46)

confirmed.statement: The paper reports one study and shares no participants with another paper. None of its 22 references is by Kang or Kim. No other entry in candidates.json is by Taegon Kang and Kyungsoon Kim or uses the 2035 task. No other form in the forms folder mentions c075. Web searches for the authors and the task title found no companion paper. The blank sample_overlap is right.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 1-10; references, PDF pp. 9-10 (journal pp. 48-49); candidates.json; forms folder

confirmed.statement: The other participant fields match the text: two domestic universities (국내 2개 대학 재학생), IT-related courses (IT관련 과목을 학습하는 학생들), 121 men and 43 women, and population students. Country South Korea is an inference from 국내 (domestic) in a Korean journal, and the form says so.
The form's participants quote is verbatim, and its locators give the right pages and sections.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5 (journal p. 44), Section 3.1; PDF p. 6 (journal p. 45), Section 4.1; Figure 1, PDF p. 4 (journal p. 43)

confirmed.statement: Criterion 2 holds for S1 alone: 164 people analyzed. Each randomized stratum alone also has more than 50: 81 in B1 vs B2 and 83 in A1 vs A2.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5 (journal p. 44), Section 3.1; Table 4, PDF p. 7 (journal p. 46)

summary: All participant counts in the form match the PDF: 164 people analyzed (A 83, B 81; A1 43, A2 40, B1 41, B2 40), counted as people and not outputs, consistent with every reported df, t, and SE, with no count at assignment or attrition stated and no sample shared with another study or paper. The only defect is that participants.who says year and major were 'not collected' where the paper says they were not collected systematically, a wording fix that leaves criterion 2 intact because each randomized stratum alone has more than 50 people (81 and 83).
